dc_components.title: Frequently asked questions
dc_components.subtitle: Everything you need to know about LaunchPad. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.

items.question: How do I get started with LaunchPad?
items.answer: Getting started is easy! Sign up for a free account, and you'll have access to our starter tier immediately. Follow our quick-start guide to deploy your first project in under 5 minutes.

items.question: Can I migrate my existing project to LaunchPad?
items.answer: Absolutely! We support migrations from most major platforms. Our CLI tool can help automate the process, and our support team is available to assist with complex migrations.

items.question: What languages and frameworks are supported?
items.answer: LaunchPad supports all major languages and frameworks including React, Vue, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Go, and more. If you can containerize it, we can run it.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: We bill monthly or annually (with a 20% discount for annual plans). You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time. We prorate any changes to your subscription.

dc_components.title: We're on a mission to help teams ship faster
dc_components.subtitle: Founded in 2020, LaunchPad was born from the frustration of slow, complex development workflows. Today, we help thousands of teams build and ship products faster than ever.

dc_components.title: Our Story
dc_components.content:
We believe that building great software shouldn't be complicated. That's why we created LaunchPad - a platform that handles the complexity so you can focus on what matters: building products your users love.

Our team is made up of engineers, designers, and product people who have experienced the pain of slow development cycles firsthand. We've built LaunchPad to be the tool we always wished we had.

dc_components.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our team.

items.question: How long does onboarding take?
items.answer: Most teams complete onboarding within 3-5 business days. Our migration specialists handle the heavy lifting so your team can focus on building.

items.question: Do you offer custom SLAs?
items.answer: Yes. Enterprise customers receive custom SLAs with guaranteed uptime, response times, and dedicated support channels tailored to their needs.

items.question: Can I start small and scale later?
items.answer: Absolutely. Start with our Starter plan and upgrade as your needs grow. All plans include the same core platform — you only pay for the resources and support level you need.
